Built To Solve Real-World
MSP Challenges.

Guardz is purpose-built for MSPs, engineered not only to strengthen the security of their clients, but to solve the everyday operational challenges MSPs face, by turning security outcomes into clear business impact.

Get Started

Evolving Cyber Threats

Adversaries target every layer with phishing, session hijacking, ransomware and more. Legacy, siloed tools miss behavioral anomalies, and malicious processes, allowing persistent footholds evade detection until it's too late.

Workflow Overload

Juggling clients, tool sprawl, and alert fatigue drains resources and drives operational strain. Without central control and automation, technicians lose hours to manual tasks, made worse by an industry-wide talent shortage.

Business Growth

Real growth comes from turning cybersecurity into a repeatable, high-value service that not only lands new business but proves its worth over time. Evolving MSPs must overcome tech and business hurdles to scale and compete.

The Guardz Difference:
A Cybersecurity Platform 
That Connects the Dots

A unified cybersecurity platform provides core protections, working together in one place to eliminate vendor sprawl. Unlike platforms that connect 3rd-party tools, a truly unified platform has native controls, normalized data, and no extra licensing.

Natively-Built Security Controls

The right security controls architected to detect, analyze, and eliminate cyber-attacks across identities, endpoints, email, cloud, data, and more, all from a single platform.

Guardz was built from the ground up as a unified, AI-powered security platform, that correlates signals to real identities, uncovers patterns of behavior, and identifies true risk by connecting the dots across the stack.
